meta.title: Global 200cc+ Motorcycle Brand Landscape
meta.scope: Motorcycle brands outside mainland China · models of 200cc and above · current official line-ups
principles: Covers manufacturers based outside mainland China; Chinese brands (CFMOTO, QJMOTOR, Kove, Voge, Zontes and others) are out of scope.
A model is listed only if it belongs to the brand's current official line-up in at least one major market.
Different trims and model years of one family are merged into a single primary model.
Displacement is the manufacturer's official figure in cc.
List prices are market-specific and are not shown in this edition; no cross-market price is invented.
No spec sheet is published in this edition: the board covers brand, model, displacement and body type.
sources: Official manufacturer model pages and line-ups
Regional distributor catalogues used only to confirm that a model is on sale
